items.title: Startups on Ashby pay more and hire more remotely: 50,000 open jobs compared with Greenhouse
items.pt:
Ashby is the hiring system many AI companies and venture-backed startups moved to in the last few years: OpenAI, Snowflake, Harvey, Airwallex, Applied Intuition, Crusoe, Mistral, Legora. Like Greenhouse, every Ashby job board has a public JSON API. We read all the boards we know of every night, so we can compare the two.

Numbers below are from the November 18, 2026 build: 50,121 open jobs on 2,180 Ashby boards and 164,004 on 3,976 Greenhouse boards.

items.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
items.pt: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual address

items.title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
items.pt: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. items.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
items.pt: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed. These claims, however, are scattered across papers, vendor reports and disclosures and are rarely comparable.
